notes.title: Update November 2024
notes.content:
Very minor fixes
- Skills don't miss when targeting yourself anymore.
- Adjusted Blind status hit% change.
- Wait command advances thrice as fast all altered states, this should give extra utility, especially at start of game.
- Hopefully achievements are working again now.

notes.title: Hotfix! Uhhh 1?
notes.content:
Hi, Captain to the speak!

An issue has been resolved, thanks to the community for alerting of its existence.

[list]
[*]Fix: Under specific situations, some animation graphics fail to be disposed and crash the game.
[/list]

That's about it for now, see ya soon space cowboy!

notes.title: Quick Patch v1.01
notes.content:
Added spacing to morse code to make it slightly easier to read.
Missing text on some enemy descriptions.
Mistake in option 3 for an INN.
Removed jitter when downscaling is turned off.
Mines area closed again, work in progress.
Fixed crash when losing a battle.
Formatting error in menu.

notes.title: Update 1.00
notes.content:
Version 1.00 - Updated first part
[list]
[*] Added Battle retry menu.
[*] Revamped options menu layout.
[*] Added options for multiple gamepad icons and screen downscale (EXPERIMENTAL!).
[*] New and polished cutscenes.
[*] New Abasantis quest.
[*] Plethora of bug fixes.
[*] Rebalancing.
[/list]

This is not a content update and focuses mainly on bug fixes. Three years of mostly bugfixing, yes. But there's one singular new sidequest.

notes.title: THE Captain's Log #1 - June Update
notes.content:
¡Hello! The captain speaking (?). First of all let me thank everyone contributing with their impressions about the game and that, after all the intention behind the early access is to improve the game based on the community's feedback.

Speaking of other things, I'll include some of the visual improvements in the game. I think it's a bit more interesting.

First off, some rework on some areas of maps, especially the worldmap. One of such places is the Forest of Phamas. It was pending to do, and it will help find the entrance to the forest. Before it was kind of bland.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897228/9743655fe07aef2e4b8211dd1d85420536a0fafd.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897228/9743655fe07aef2e4b8211dd1d85420536a0fafd.gif[/img][/url]
[i]A GIF summarizing the process.[/i]

The other important aspect is some dialogs rewrites, some of them had a couple years already since I wrote them, and they feel a bit hard to read (especially the dreaded instructions on how to get to Aleko!). Hopefully it does a better job on explaining now.

[previewyoutube=l9QgmKa__4U;full][/previewyoutube]

As an advance, there will be another update like this one next month. This update will be comprised mainly of some structure changes for the intro, with the objective of presenting the information in a better way. It's a bigger change so it's still in process.

The following is the full changelog for the last 2 weeks of development.

[quote]DONE	Bug: Cave effect getting stuck if you die inside Haleko and etc.
DONE	Bug: Twin flames achievement check was bugged.
DONE	Bug: Hikari in Limbo. Dying against the Red Wyvern causes the GameOver event to get stuck.
DONE	Bug: Enemies around Red Wyvern shoouldn't get in the way mid-event.
DONE	Bug: Intro flames wave effects are not working.
DONE	Bug: Fix self-healing flip issue when character is at left side (I put some <= or something like that, EEEEEDYOT!).
DONE	Bug: Remove damage when over press tile @ training cave.
DONE	Lore: Explain the gold "system", how your money goes directly to your account and all that.
DONE	Lore: Extra small scene before Training Cave (explain where is Hikari and what is she doing).
DONE	Lore: Explain bank better. C:
DONE	Lore: When trying to exit through left-side from Eddie's docks, there is no notice from mom or something (bugged?)
DONE	Lore: Dialog addendum after fighting against Vance. "What a weird guy."
DONE	Balance: Nerf Red Wyvern's life. It's absurd right now.
DONE	Balance: Scan should not fail. Ever.
DONE	Balance: Long-range attacks should not be affected by some counter-attacks (might have to do a melee element).
DONE	Balance: Lower Mole speed 1 point (maybe 2).
DONE	Polish: Phamas forest entry should be more obvious!
DONE	Polish: At least add some ocean wave background sound @ ship (intro)
DONE	Polish: Aleko has some tiles bad.
DONE	Polish: Move Rei one tile down, so she doesn't get obscured by the ship's thing.
DONE	Polish: Auto-save icon.
DONE	Polish: Add explanation for encyclopaedia
DONE	Feature: Add sound/flash event support on Custom Animation Editor
DONE	Feature: Naming screen, probably needs polish. Add legends (buttons) and set starting position over the Finish thing?
DONE	Deprecated: REMOVE THE SPECIAL ABILITY CONTROLS PROMPT @ training cave statue
[/quote]

Thanks for reading and see you soon in the next update!
